caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile with a fringed border made up of red, blue, and olive green threads extending from the edges. The design is sectioned into geometric rows and blocks featuring various symmetrical patterns in red, dark blue, and olive green on a beige background. Motifs include stylized eight-pointed stars, floral shapes, birds (some resembling chickens or roosters in red), and quadrupeds with horns (possibly deer or stags in blue). Some areas have floral medallions or stylized sunbursts, and some zones divide motifs with diagonal bands containing additional geometric and floral details. In one rectangular section, there is a block of text in red and blue, which reads: “SELINA SALMAN SOMERSET WEAVER HILTON 1832.” The overall composition is a regular repeat of these colored motifs and borders, creating a patchwork-like appearance.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
